# Zhengzhou Huaer Electro-Optics Technology Co., Ltd.

> > A leading Chinese manufacturer of dental equipment and hand sanitizer products, offering portable dental chairs, handpieces, and bulk antiseptic solutions with ISO and GMP certifications.

Zhengzhou Huaer Electro-Optics Technology specializes in dental equipment manufacturing and personal hygiene products. The company supplies portable dental units, dental handpieces, and high-volume antiseptic hand sanitizers with 75% alcohol formulations to wholesale and bulk buyers globally.
